units.source_text: [\[39\]](#part1333.html#w39) 当时习惯：男女相别时，相约在再会之前各不恋爱别人，

en.t: According to the custom of the time,
when a man and woman parted,
they promised not to fall in love with anyone else before they met again,

units.source_text: 女的在内裙带、男的在兜裆布带上打一个结，表示立誓。

en.t: the woman tied a knot in the cord of her inner skirt,
and the man tied one in the cord of his loincloth,
as a sign of their vow.
